UPDATE sources
SET derniere_ingestion = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE actif = TRUE
RETURNING code, derniere_ingestion;

SELECT id, code, nom, rss_url, fiabilite, thematiques
FROM sources
WHERE actif = TRUE
  AND rss_url IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO articles (
  source_id,
  titre,
  url,
  contenu,
  date_publication,
  langue,
  hash_contenu,
  metadata
)
SELECT
  s.id,
  '{{ $json.titre.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.url.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.description.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.date_publication ? "'" + $json.date_publication + "'::timestamp" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.langue }}',
  '{{ $json.hash_contenu }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb
FROM sources s
WHERE s.code = '{{ $json.source_code }}'
ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, titre, url;
